channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: A major Rutland area drug dealer was sentenced to over seven years in prison. Guadalupe Vargas ran a drug operation using apartments in Rutland City. Authorities seized drugs, guns, and cash linked to gang activity and a California murder.

Vermont received nearly one hundred ninety million dollars in federal funding to improve rural healthcare. Projects include a new health center in Canaan and expanded women's health services in Rutland. The program focuses on access, workforce support, and care coordination.

A Rutland man was sentenced to nearly eight years in prison for child sexual abuse material offenses. Matthew Kielecki pleaded guilty to distributing images of assaults on children under twelve. Police also found drugs and firearms at his home during the investigation.

Wreaths Across America needs more than four thousand three hundred wreaths to honor Vermont's fallen veterans. Thousands of graves remain without wreaths as Veterans Day approaches. Vermonters are encouraged to sponsor wreaths to pay tribute.
